newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six, Panamaxes continue to rise.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six, Panamaxes continue to rise.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose six points to 1,349 on Monday.

Panamaxes continued to make the pace with Dreyfus rumoured to have fixed 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for prompt dates at $24.25 or $24.50 combo and Delphic Flame 64,000 dwt fixed on subjects delivery N.Spain trip via E.C.S.America to the Far East at close to a firmer $13,000 daily.
Andre fixed 54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Japan for mid-July on private terms in an active Far East Panamax market.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 20 to five points up and turnover was 118 lots.
